name: start;again
source:
You see an unfamiliar location.

Unfamiliar faces.

You have two hours to escape.

__________

Awakened in an unfamiliar location, four strangers are forced into a life-or-death situation they must escape within two hours.

How did they get there?

Who is behind it all?

Who can be trusted?

…And why does it feel as though some of these strangers may not be strangers after all?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
映入眼帘的是陌生的地方。

陌生的面孔。

你有两小时可以逃出去。

__________

四个素不相识的人在陌生的地方醒来，被迫卷入一场生死考验。他们必须在两小时内逃出去。

他们是怎么来到这里的？

谁在幕后操纵这一切？

谁值得信任？

……为什么这些陌生人中，有些人却似乎并不陌生？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927140/]Steam[/url]]
